messages:
emma-oncall: FYI getting multiple p99 latency alerts for hosted-api-prod. p99 jumped from ~450ms -> ~3.2s over the last 10m. Several customers reporting timeouts. Ticket #6452 attached.
ryan-sre: looking now. can you paste the prom query you used?
emma-oncall: prom query I ran: histogram_quantile(0.99, sum(rate(request_duration_seconds_bucket{route=\"/v1/generate\"}[1m])) by (le, model, region)). results: eu-west-1 shows 3.2s, us-east-1 ~600ms. Model: redwood-xl-8k.
jess-runtime: I can see increased tail and longer batch queue times on the xl-8k pools. logs show repeated "KV cache miss, recomputing attention" and a few transient OOM restarts on shard-3.
tom-platform: we rolled redwood-xl-8k v2.1 last night (quant kernel change + attention fusion). Was canary at 5% -> 100% at 02:40 UTC.
\ranalyst? oops\ranalyst: (ignore)
ryan-sre: OK likely regression from rollout + batch dynamics. Immediate mitigations: 1) route affected tenants to fallback model (redwood-lg-4k) 2) enable circuit-breaker/open for long-running requests 3) reduce batch window for xl-8k pool 4) scale up workers if needed.
anita-product: which tenants are hitting this hardest? support ticket lists tenant 12345 and 67890.
emma-oncall: tenant 12345 currently has highest error rate. I can apply routing rule now if you want.
ryan-sre: Do it. Also enable a temporary soft rate-limit for requests > 4096 tokens for those tenants.
emma-oncall: Applying routing rule and token threshold rate-limit.
infra-bot: Routing change queued: change_id=chg-20260301-778. Action: route tenant=12345,67890 -> redwood-lg-4k in eu-west-1/us-east-1.
infra-bot: Rate-limit policy applied: tenant=12345,67890 max_concurrent_longgens=8, token_threshold=4096.
support-bot: Notified customer(s) with temporary mitigation and ask for repro payloads.
siddharth-eng: I'm patching runtime: reduce batch_window_ms from 50 -> 10 for xl-8k pool and disable continuous batching for requests > 2048 tokens. Pushing now.
jess-runtime: logs after patch show queue depth dropping on xl-8k pool. also enabling prefix/KV caching aggressively for those tenants (TTL 30m).
ryan-sre: If p99 doesn't drop in 5-10m, rollback v2.1 for xl-8k and fallback to v2.0.
tom-platform: initiating rollback plan for xl-8k v2.1 -> v2.0. will start canary rollback to 10% now.
infra-bot: Rollback job started: job_id=rb-20260301-009. canary 10% -> monitor.
emma-oncall: Quick curl examples I used to apply routing and breaker: 
```
# route
curl -X POST https://admin.redwood.internal/routing/apply \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN" \
  -d '{"tenant_id": ["12345","67890"], "target_model": "redwood-lg-4k"}'
# set cb
curl -X POST https://admin.redwood.internal/circuit_breaker \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN" \
  -d '{"route":"/v1/generate","p99_threshold_ms":2000,"open_seconds":300}'
```
ryan-sre: Observability checklist we ran: - confirm p99 by region/model (prom) - check worker restart/OOMs (k8s events) - sampling traces for full KV recompute (jaeger) - trace logs for model kernel latencies (runtime logs).
anita-product: support asked customers to share a sample request; they sent a 8k token prompt. good catch.
jess-runtime: After route + batch window reduction + cache enable: p99 for tenant 12345 dropped from 3.2s -> ~520ms in eu-west-1 within 6m. Errors/timeouts dropped to zero.
emma-oncall: Great. leaving routing rule and rate-limits in place for now. monitoring for 1h.
siddharth-eng: we'll finish rollback if metrics don't stabilize after canary rollback.
tom-platform: I've paused further rollouts until postmortem.
ryan-sre: Postmortem owners: jess-runtime (root cause), tom-platform (release process), siddharth-eng (runtime mitigation), anita-product (customer comms).
emma-oncall: Closing loop in support ticket with summary and mitigation steps. I'll keep thread open for 60m.
support-bot: Customer notified, asked if they'd like the fallback to remain or wait for fix.
emma-oncall: final check at +45m: p99 stable ~480-600ms across regions for affected tenants. no new errors. closing thread. :white_check_mark:
